fields.label: Remove Images
fields.help: Strip image references (![alt](url)) from the markdown files.

fields.label: Normalize Formatting
fields.help: Standardize markdown formatting (heading levels, list markers, emphasis syntax).

fields.label: Remove Extra Whitespace
fields.help: Collapse runs of blank lines and trailing spaces.

fields.label: Strip HTML Comments
fields.help: Remove <!-- … --> HTML comment blocks from the markdown.

fields.label: Normalize Line Endings
fields.help: Convert all line endings to Unix-style (LF).

fields.label: Input Directory
fields.help: Folder name (relative to the data root) containing the raw markdown files to clean.

fields.label: Output Directory
fields.help: Folder name where cleaned markdown files are written.

fields.label: Backup Original
fields.help: Create a backup copy of each file before overwriting it with the cleaned version.
